richiami.difetto: THE MANUFACTURER ADVISES NOT TO USE THE VEHICLE UNTIL AFTER RECTIFICATION. A potential issue regarding assembly/tightening of the low voltage C19 cable could cause it to deviate from its correct position which could compromise the isolation of the cable during the normal operation of the vehicle. This could cause a short circuit and potentially increase the risk of a fire. It may also cause the loss of all electrical power.
richiami.rimedio: Vehicles will have the cable checked and if necessary correctly routed.
richiami.titolo: A potential issue regarding assembly/tightening of the low  voltage C19 cable

richiami.difetto: The backrest frame of driver and passenger seats could be welded incorrectly and result in the backrest becoming loose. If the backrest becomes loose this could affect the driver�s ability to control the vehicle and the driver and passenger seats may not perform as intended in the event of a collision.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and visually check the backrest frame welding. If the frame is not welded to the correct specification the seat will be changed.
richiami.titolo: BACKREST FRAME OF DRIVER AND PASSENGER SEATS MAY BE WELDED INCORRECTLY
